greet.text: (He breaks off humming as you come closer.) Far enough. Hands where I can see them. ...You're the one who's been following the light. Mirela's by the fire. Walk slow.

choices.text: (Outlaw) Easy. I'm on the same notice board as you.
What was that you were singing?

who.text: The Thornwood Free. Free of taxes, free of licences, free of the garrison. Mostly free of food, lately.

outlaw.text: Ha. Then you know the rules: don't steal from the pot, and don't bring the garrison home with you.

song.text: "...and Hallam hunted the lights through a hundred nights, and caught one each night, and put it out." Hallam and the Hundred Lights. Every child in the Empire knows it. My mam sang it to keep me in bed. It worked: I was scared of wisps till I was twelve. Now I'm only scared of the garrison.

lanternfast.text: (He's humming the Hallam song, very quietly.) Lanternfast. I'd light one, but the garrison would see it from the road, and then we'd have a different sort of festival. (He nods at the dark sky.) Funny. It's the one night I feel watched by something that isn't the garrison.
